resources.string: Ibona xa amaqhosha athile kwirimothi yakho ecinezelwa kwaye iwanike umsebenzi wesitshixo okanye i-app eyahlukileyo, kwaye iqaphele ukuba yeyiphi i-app ekwisikrini ukuze iqhosha elinye lisebenze ngendlela eyahlukileyo kwi-app ye-TV. Ukucinezelwa kwezitshixo akuze kugcinwe okanye kuthunyelwe naphi na.

I-MX3 Button Mapper isebenzisa i-Accessibility Service API ye-Android ukutshintsha imisebenzi yamaqhosha erimothi yakho.

Xa ivuliwe:
• Ifunda ukucinezelwa kwamaqhosha kwirimothi yakho, ukuze ikwazi ukutshintsha amaqhosha athile ngesinye isitshixo, ukucinezela okulandelelanayo, okanye ukuvula i-app
• Iqaphela igama le-app ekwisikrini ngoku, ukuze iqhosha (umz. Itshaneli phezulu/ezantsi) lenze into eyahlukileyo ngaphakathi kwi-app ye-TV

Ayifundi okuqulathwe sisikrini, umbhalo, okanye iiphasiwedi. Ukucinezelwa kwezitshixo namagama ee-app kusetyenziswa kwesi sixhobo kuphela, ngexesha ekwenzeka ngalo. Akuze kugcinwe (ngaphandle kokuba uvule iilog zokusombulula iingxaki ezingezantsi), kwaye akuze kwabelwane ngako okanye kuthunyelwe ngaphandle kwesixhobo. Le app ayinalo ufikelelo lwe-intanethi.

Ukuba uyavuma, i-app iya kusebenzisa i-%1$s ukuvula inkonzo yayo yofikeleleko endaweni yakho. Unokuyicima nangaliphi na ixesha kwi-Iisetingi → Ufikeleleko.
Shicilela iqhosha lemaphu kwakhona (ukulungisa ingxaki kuphela)
%1$s qalisa/yekisa umqondiso wobubhali wenjongo (ncamathisela ngokupheleleyo ‘auth: XXXX’ esuka kwi %1$s’s Jonga isikrini seenjongo)
Nika imvume ye %1$s, emva koko uvule le nkonzo phantsi koFikelelo
Uhlobo lweTV (ichaphazela i %1$s iqhosha leTV ngokukodwa)
